entities.name: Urza
entities.description: One of the warring brothers; his apprentice is Tawnos.

entities.name: Mishra
entities.description: Urza's brother; assaults Kroog, kills the Ivory Tower delegates.

entities.name: Kayla
entities.description: Daughter of the King of Kroog, having an affair with Tawnos.

entities.name: Tawnos
entities.description: Urza's apprentice, having an affair with Kayla.

entities.name: Harbin
entities.description: Kayla's child, disfigured by Mishra and later initiated as a warrior-priest of Argive.

entities.name: King of Kroog
entities.description: Kayla's father, killed by a dragon engine.

entities.name: Ivory Tower
entities.description: A council assembled to neutralize the brothers.

entities.name: Terisia City
entities.description: City conquered after the treason of the Brotherhood of Gix.

entities.name: Brotherhood of Gix
entities.description: Group whose treason enabled the conquest of Terisia City.

entities.name: Phyrexian demon
entities.description: A demon who desires the powerstones, defeated when the brothers band together.

entities.name: Argive
entities.description: Nation of which Harbin becomes a warrior-priest.

entities.name: Third Path
entities.description: A featured event of the comic.

entities.name: Brothers' War
entities.description: The war between Urza and Mishra.

events.summary: Kayla has an affair with Tawnos and Harbin is born.
events.quote: Kayla is having an affair with Urza 's apprentice, Tawnos . Harbin is born

events.summary: Mishra assaults Kroog and cuts off Harbin's left ear.
events.quote: Mishra permanently disfigures Harbin by cutting off his left ear

events.summary: The King of Kroog is killed by a dragon engine.
events.quote: The King of Kroog — Kayla's father — is killed by a dragon engine .

events.summary: The Ivory Tower council assembles for the first time to neutralize the brothers.
events.quote: The council at the Ivory Tower assembles for the first time, in a bid to neutralize the Brothers.

events.summary: Mishra kills the Ivory Tower delegates and Terisia City is conquered after the Brotherhood of Gix's treason.
events.quote: The delegates of the Ivory Tower are killed by Mishra, and Terisia City is conquered after the treason of the Brotherhood of Gix .

events.summary: A Phyrexian demon seeks the powerstones for godlike power; in the end the brothers band together to defeat him.
events.quote: In the end, the brothers band together to defeat him.

events.summary: Harbin is initiated as a warrior-priest of Argive.
events.quote: Harbin is initiated as a warrior-priest of Argive .
